name: Montage Los Cabos, Mexico
insider_take: Montage Los Cabos sits on 39 pristine acres where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez, offering unparalleled views of the iconic El Arco rock formation from almost every suite.
whats_special: This ultra-luxury resort features a Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Course that winds through desert landscapes and oceanfront holes. The property's unique location on Santa Maria Bay provides some of the calmest swimmable waters in Los Cabos, while the spa incorporates traditional Mexican healing traditions with indigenous ingredients like damiana and desert sage.
pro_tip: Book a suite on the upper floors facing northwest for the best views of Land's End and spectacular sunsets over the Pacific, especially during whale watching season (December-April).
dont_miss: The resort's private beach club on Santa Maria Bay offers world-class snorkeling in protected waters teeming with tropical fish. Take the complimentary sunset cruise to El Arco, or experience the chef's tasting menu at Mezcal restaurant, which features the largest collection of premium mezcals in Baja California Sur.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location with pristine beaches
Exceptional luxury accommodations with private terraces
Multiple gourmet dining venues with ocean views
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Remote location requires transportation for local exploration
